text: Phyllotaxy is the pattern of arrangement of .
solution: Correct Answer: Option (B) - leaves. Phyllotaxy is the pattern or arrangement of leaves on the stem or branch. It is typically of three types: alternate, opposite, and whorled.

text: Which of the following are characteristic features of Solanaceae family? (a) Flowers are bisexual and actinomorphic (b) Calyx have five sepals and are united (c) Androecium have five stamens and are epipetalous (d) Ovary is inferior Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
solution: Correct Answer: Option (B) - (a), (b) and (c) only. Stems are modified into flattened photosynthetic structures in Opuntia (flattened cladode/phylloclade) and fleshy cylindrical structures in Euphorbia.

text: In angiosperms, root hairs arise from which one of the following regions of the root?
solution: Correct Answer: Option (D) - The region of maturation. In caryopsis (grain of maize/cereals), the fruit wall (pericarp) is fused with the seed coat. The seed has a large endosperm and a single shield-shaped cotyledon known as scutellum.

text: Which of the following floral formula is the correct floral formula of Solanaceae family? (Refer to the image options)
solution: Correct Answer: Option (B) - (B). The correct floral formula of Solanaceae is: ⊕ ⚥ K(5) C(5) A5 G(2) (bisexual, actinomorphic, calyx 5 united, corolla 5 united, epipetalous stamens 5, bicarpellary syncarpous superior ovary with oblique septum).

text: In racemose inflorescence, .

solution: Correct Answer: Option (D) - Flowers are borne in an acropetal succession. In calotropis and guava, a pair of leaves arise at each node and lie opposite to each other, representing opposite phyllotaxy.

solution: Correct Answer: Option (B) - Aleurone layer. In monocot seeds (like cereals/maize), the outer covering of endosperm separates the embryo by a proteinaceous layer called the aleurone layer.
